audit_status.review_note: Draft translation of 2 Chronicles 19 faithful to Hebrew; preserves judicial reform language, prophetic rebuke, and cultic-reform terms. A few phrases (v.2, v.10) flagged for witness review.

verses.restored: Jehoshaphat king of Judah returned to his house in peace in Jerusalem.

familiar.text: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.

modern.text: When Jehoshaphat king of Judah had returned safely to his home in Jerusalem,

original.text: וַ֠יָּשָׁב יְהוֹשָׁפָ֨ט מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֧ה אֶל בֵּית֛וֹ בְּשָׁל֖וֹם לִֽירוּשָׁלִָֽם

verses.restored: Jehu son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him and said to the king, “Shall you help the wicked and love those who hate YHWH? Therefore wrath is upon you from before YHWH.”

familiar.text: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to king Jehoshaphat, Shouldest thou help the ungodly, and love them that hate the LORD? therefore is wrath upon thee from before the LORD.

notes.title: short
notes.body: Direct prophetic rebuke; Hebrew verb-form emphatic—tone confrontational.

modern.text: Jehu son of Hanani the seer went out to confront him and said to King Jehoshaphat, “Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the LORD? Because of this, the wrath of the LORD is upon you.

original.text: וַיֵּצֵ֣א אֶל פָּנָ֗יו יֵה֣וּא בֶן חֲנָ֘נִי֮ הַחֹזֶה֒ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֔ט הֲלָרָשָׁ֣ע לַעְזֹ֔ר וּלְשֹׂנְאֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תֶּאֱהָ֑ב וּבָזֹאת֙ עָלֶ֣יךָ קֶּ֔צֶף מִלִּפְנֵ֖י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Yet good things were found in you: for you removed the Asherah poles from the land and set your heart to seek YHWH.

familiar.text: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee, in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land, and hast prepared thine heart to seek God.

modern.text: However, some good is found in you, for you have removed the Asherah poles from the land and have set your heart on seeking God.” Jehoshaphat’s Reforms

original.text: אֲבָ֕ל דְּבָרִ֥ים טוֹבִ֖ים נִמְצְא֣וּ עִמָּ֑ךְ כִּֽי בִעַ֤רְתָּ הָאֲשֵׁרוֹת֙ מִן הָאָ֔רֶץ וַהֲכִינ֥וֹתָ לְבָבְךָ֖ לִדְרֹ֥שׁ הָֽאֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem; and he went out again through the people from Beersheba to Mount Ephraim, and brought them back to YHWH, the God of their fathers.

familiar.text: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem: and he went out again through the people from Beersheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back unto the LORD God of their fathers.

modern.text: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, and once again he went out among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim and turned them back to the LORD, the God of their fathers.

original.text: וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיָּ֜שָׁב וַיֵּצֵ֣א בָעָ֗ם מִבְּאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֨בַע֙ עַד הַ֣ר אֶפְרַ֔יִם וַיְשִׁיבֵ֕ם אֶל יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fortified cities of Judah, city by city.

familiar.text: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Judah, city by city,

modern.text: He appointed judges in the land, in each of the fortified cities of Judah.

original.text: וַיַּעֲמֵ֨ד שֹֽׁפְטִ֜ים בָּאָ֗רֶץ בְּכָל עָרֵ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה הַבְּצֻר֖וֹת לְעִ֥יר וָעִֽיר

verses.restored: And he said to the judges, “See what you do; for you do not judge for man but for YHWH, who is with you in the matter of judgment.”

familiar.text: And said to the judges, Take heed what ye do: for ye judge not for man, but for the LORD, who is with you in the judgment.

modern.text: Then he said to the judges, “Consider carefully what you do, for you are not judging for man, but for the LORD, who is with you when you render judgment.

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל הַשֹּֽׁפְטִ֗ים רְאוּ֙ מָֽה אַתֶּ֣ם עֹשִׂ֔ים כִּ֣י לֹ֧א לְאָדָ֛ם תִּשְׁפְּט֖וּ כִּ֣י לַיהוָ֑ה וְעִמָּכֶ֖ם בִּדְבַ֥ר מִשְׁפָּֽט

verses.restored: Now let the fear of YHWH be upon you; be careful and do it; for there is no iniquity with YHWH our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of bribes.

familiar.text: Wherefore now let the fear of the LORD be upon you; take heed and do it: for there is no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.

modern.text: And now, may the fear of the LORD be upon you. Be careful what you do, for with the LORD our God there is no injustice or partiality or bribery.”

original.text: וְעַתָּ֕ה יְהִ֥י פַֽחַד יְהוָ֖ה עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם שִׁמְר֣וּ וַעֲשׂ֔וּ כִּֽי אֵ֞ין עִם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עַוְלָ֛ה וּמַשֹּׂ֥א פָנִ֖ים וּמִקַּח שֹֽׁחַד

verses.restored: And in Jerusalem Jehoshaphat appointed of the Levites, and of the priests, and of the heads of the fathers of Israel, for the judgment of YHWH and for controversies; and they returned to Jerusalem.

familiar.text: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites, and of the priests, and of the chief of the fathers of Israel, for the judgment of the LORD, and for controversies, when they returned to Jerusalem.

modern.text: Moreover, Jehoshaphat appointed in Jerusalem some of the Levites, priests, and heads of the Israelite families to judge on behalf of the LORD and to settle disputes. And they lived in Jerusalem.

original.text: וְגַ֣ם בִּ֠ירוּשָׁלִַם הֶעֱמִ֨יד יְהוֹשָׁפָ֜ט מִן הַלְוִיִּ֣ם וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וּמֵרָאשֵׁ֤י הָאָבוֹת֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְמִשְׁפַּ֥ט יְהוָ֖ה וְלָרִ֑יב וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם

verses.restored: And he charged them, saying, “Thus you shall do in the fear of YHWH, faithfully and with a whole heart.”

familiar.text: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall ye do in the fear of the LORD, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.

modern.text: He commanded them, saying, “You must serve faithfully and wholeheartedly in the fear of the LORD.

original.text: וַיְצַ֥ו עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּ֤ה תַעֲשׂוּן֙ בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה בֶּאֱמוּנָ֖ה וּבְלֵבָ֥ב שָׁלֵֽם

verses.restored: And whatever controversy comes to you from your brethren who dwell in their cities—whether between blood and blood, or between law and commandment, statutes and judgments—warn them, that they trespass not against YHWH; and that wrath not come upon you and upon your brethren. Do this and you shall not trespass.

familiar.text: And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and judgments, ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against the LORD, and so wrath come upon you, and upon your brethren: this do, and ye shall not trespass.

notes.title: short
notes.body: Phrase 'between blood and blood' (בֵּין־דָּם לְדָם) is ambiguous in Hebrew; could mean homicide, manslaughter, or blood-claims.

modern.text: For every dispute that comes before you from your brothers who dwell in their cities—whether it regards bloodshed or some other violation of law, commandments, statutes, or ordinances—you are to warn them, so that they will not incur guilt before the LORD and wrath will not come upon you and your brothers. Do this, and you will not incur guilt.

original.text: וְכָל רִיב֩ אֲשֶׁר יָב֨וֹא עֲלֵיכֶ֜ם מֵאֲחֵיכֶ֣ם הַיֹּשְׁבִ֣ים בְּעָרֵיהֶ֗ם בֵּֽין דָּ֣ם לְדָם֮ בֵּין תּוֹרָ֣ה לְמִצְוָה֮ לְחֻקִּ֣ים וּלְמִשְׁפָּטִים֒ וְהִזְהַרְתֶּ֣ם אֹתָ֔ם וְלֹ֤א יֶאְשְׁמוּ֙ לַיהוָ֔ה וְהָֽיָה קֶ֥צֶף עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם וְעַל אֲחֵיכֶ֑ם כֹּ֥ה תַעֲשׂ֖וּן וְלֹ֥א תֶאְשָֽׁמוּ

verses.restored: And, behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all the matters of YHWH; and Zebadiah son of Ishmael is the ruler of the house of Judah for all the king’s matters; also the Levites shall be officers before you. Be courageous and act; and YHWH will be with the good.

familiar.text: And, behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the LORD; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, for all the king’s matters: also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and the LORD shall be with the good.

notes.title: short
notes.body: Role titles combine priestly, administrative, and levitical functions; 'ruler of the house' indicates royal administration.

modern.text: Note that Amariah, the chief priest, will be over you in all that pertains to the LORD, and Zebadiah son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, in all that pertains to the king. And the Levites will serve as officers before you. Act resolutely; may the LORD be with the upright!”

original.text: וְהִנֵּ֡ה אֲמַרְיָ֣הוּ כֹהֵן֩ הָרֹ֨אשׁ עֲלֵיכֶ֜ם לְכֹ֣ל דְּבַר יְהוָ֗ה וּזְבַדְיָ֨הוּ בֶן יִשְׁמָעֵ֜אל הַנָּגִ֤יד לְבֵית יְהוּדָה֙ לְכֹ֣ל דְּבַר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְשֹׁטְרִ֥ים הַלְוִיִּ֖ם לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם חִזְק֣וּ וַעֲשׂ֔וּ וִיהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִם הַטּֽוֹב

translation_notes: Divine name rendered YHWH for Hebrew יהוה. Hebrew terms are transliterated when they carry cultic or legal weight (max two per verse). Preserve literal legal phrasing (e.g., 'between blood and blood').
This chapter emphasizes judicial/administrative reform and prophetic accountability; avoid harmonizing legal ambiguity.
safety_note: Contains legal/administrative authority material; not a justification for abuse of judicial power.
